summary:
I read all of /Users/LA40057633/Project/l/stotramulu/styles/styles.css lines 1-1000 and checked each state class against index.html and public/assets/*.js. I made no edits. What matters for behaviour:

(1) PAGE SWITCHING. The four pages are toggled two ways. The home page uses inline style.display 'none'/'flex' (app.js:47,96; tracking.js:43; japamala.js:55). The reader, track and japamala pages use a .active class. .back-btn is hidden by CSS until JS writes an inline display.

(2) OVERLAYS. .search-overlay is used by both #searchOverlay and #accountOverlay. The page behind is locked with body.style.overflow='hidden', so each overlay must scroll itself.

(3) STATE CLASSES SET BY JS:
- .reminder-banner.show
- .scroll-top-btn.visible
- .origin-block.visible
- body.show-meanings (shows the meanings)
- .meaning-toggle.on (also copied into aria-pressed by reader-navigation.js:363-366)
- mark / mark.current (search matches)
- .rs-mic.listening and .mic-btn.listening (voice search is recording)
- .jm-mode-btn.active
- .jm-bead.cur, .jm-fbead.cur, .jm-fbead.pop, .jm-flowbead.cur
- .jm-svg.celebrate
- JS-created .jm-confetti and .particle elements

(4) JAPAMALA SVG NEEDS CSS TO DRAW AT ALL. The thread line/ellipses have no stroke attribute, so without .jm-thread they are invisible. The JS-built tassel paths have no fill or stroke, so without .jm-tassel-thread they render as black blobs. .jm-fbead needs transform-box:fill-box and transform-origin:center, otherwise the pop scale flings the bead toward the SVG origin. JS moves beads by setting transform and opacity every animation frame, so no transform transitions may reach them.

(5) MULTI-LINE VERSES. .slokam-text { white-space: pre-line } is the only rule that turns the \n in verse data into visible line breaks.

(6) CUSTOM PROPERTIES. No JS reads the :root variables in lines 1-10. But japamala-3d.css:75,88, which is being kept, uses var(--gold-light). --reader-font-size is not defined in styles.css: reader.js:147 sets it, reading.css:2 gives its default, and reading.css:40,88 uses it. The new system must define a default for it. JS also writes inline font-size in px on .slokam-text and .slokam-meaning (reader.js:55,146), so CSS font sizes on those are overridden.

(7) CROSS-FILE DEPENDENCIES (other stylesheets):
- .reader-search .rs-nav sets display:inline-flex, but reader.js:346 hides the buttons with the hidden attribute. That only works because of design-system.css:23 `[hidden]{display:none !important}` (and reading.css:512). The new system must include a global [hidden] rule.
- design-system.css:32 hides the empty back-button slot using the back button's inline style.
- design-system.css:257 supplies display:flex for .jm-modes; line 862 only sets gap.

(8) JS REPLACES CLASSES ON TWO ELEMENTS:
- app.js:57 overwrites #readerTitleSection className with 'reader-title-section ' + cfg.theme on every reader open. Any extra class put on it in the markup is lost.
- japamala.js:111/186/238 set the bead classes with setAttribute('class').

(9) OVERFLOW AND STICKY. Horizontal scroll is blocked by body overflow-x:hidden (line 19), html,body overflow-x:hidden plus max-width:100% (line 732), and html overflow-x:clip (design-system.css:13). Because html's overflow is not visible, body's overflow-x:hidden is not passed to the viewport, so body becomes its own scroll container. By the CSS spec that stops a sticky header (or bottom bar) from sticking. I could not confirm this in a browser because the sandbox blocked headless Chrome. For the rewrite: set horizontal-overflow control on html only (for example `overflow-x:hidden; overflow-x:clip`), not on body.

(10) STACKING ORDER. Lines 1-1000 use these z-index values:
- fixed background layers and .reader-deity-bg: 0
- pages: 1 (position relative)
- .scroll-top-btn: 200
- .search-overlay: 500
- .jm-confetti: 700

Values later in the file: day-sheet-overlay 600 (line 1094), 550 (line 1386), and the admin layers and toasts at 850/860/900/950 (lines 1283-1329). design-system.css also has a sticky header at 40 and a skip-link at 1000. .header z-index:100 (line 97) does nothing because .header has no position in this file.

(11) PRINT, SCROLL-PADDING, REDUCED MOTION. There are no print rules and no scroll-padding in lines 1-1000; they live at styles.css 1552+, reading.css:38/66+ and design-system.css:13/184. The only reduced-motion rule in range is lines 78-80.

(12) DEAD CODE. These can be dropped:
- lines 951-1000: .mala-style-*, .mala-card, .mala-stage/.mala-ring/.mala-strand-wrap, .mala-svg/.mala-thread/.mala-bead-svg(.filled/.active)/.mala-guru/.mala-tassel*/.mala-hand(.push), and keyframes beadGlowSvg/handPush. None of these appear in index.html or JS.
- .jm-full-count and .jm-full-of (909-911): #jmFullCount and #jmFlowCount do not exist, and JS checks for them before use (japamala.js:221,277).
- .welcome-section .om-symbol and omPulse: .om-symbol has no references.
- .mala-* in general: no references.

mustPreserve.why: The home page is visible by default with no class. JS hides and shows it with inline style.display 'none'/'flex' (app.js:47,96; tracking.js:43; japamala.js:55). goHome always forces display:flex, so a new layout must be flex-based, or the JS must be changed. z-index:1 keeps it above the fixed background layers at z-index 0.

The reader view only appears through .active (app.js:48,97; tracking.js:44; japamala.js:56). experience.js:64 finds the visible page by checking .active. If this is lost the reader never shows, or shows on top of home.
Toggled by tracking.js:45 and app.js:49,98. tracking.js:20 only re-renders the months when #trackPage has .active.

Toggled by japamala.js:58 and app.js:50,100. The Space-bar counter only works while this page has .active (japamala.js:484). The whole page is the tap-to-count surface (index.html:1152 onclick=bumpJapa).

#backBtn has no inline style on first load, so CSS must hide it on home. JS then writes inline display 'block'/'none' (app.js:51,101; tracking.js:46; japamala.js:59). design-system.css:32 hides the empty header slot using .back-btn:not([style]) and [style*=none]. The !important overrides cancel the old absolute positioning from line 134, which overlapped the title.

mustPreserve.declarations: position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:500; display:none; overflow-y:auto; padding:90px 18px 40px | .active{display:block; animation:fadeInUp .3s}
mustPreserve.why: Used by both #searchOverlay and #accountOverlay (index.html:1043,1061). Opened and closed by app.js:141,148,90; tracking.js:59,64; japamala.js:51. JS locks the page with body.style.overflow='hidden', so the overlay must scroll itself (overflow-y:auto) or long results and account content can't be reached. z-index 500 must stay above the header and pages, and below the day-sheet (600), confetti (700) and admin/toast layers (850-950).
Gives smooth momentum scrolling inside these scroll containers on iOS versions before 13, which matters for the older-device audience.
app.js:279-281 adds and removes .show. The close control's inline onclick removes .show. Without these rules the banner is either always visible or never visible.
app.js:115 toggles .visible when scrollY > 400. Its position must not cover other fixed controls, such as a future bottom nav.

Meanings are always in the markup (reader.js:76) and are shown only by the body class, which reader.js:155-170 toggles and restores from localStorage. reader.js:264 includes meanings in search only when the class is present. Without this rule meanings are always shown or never shown.
app.js:70,72 adds .visible only when a stotram has origin text, and otherwise empties the block.

mustPreserve.declarations: .meaning-toggle{cursor:pointer; user-select:none} .toggle-switch{position:relative; width:48px; height:26px} .toggle-switch::after{content:''; position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:20px; height:20px} .meaning-toggle.on .toggle-switch::after{left:24px} (+ .on track colour)
mustPreserve.why: #meaningToggle is a div with onclick. reader.js:157,170 toggles .on, and reader-navigation.js:360-366 adds role=button, tabindex and aria-pressed copied from .on. The knob position and colour are the only visual sign that meanings are on. Without position:relative the knob ::after escapes the switch.

Verse data uses \n line breaks (reader.js:39-50 splits some, and single-row blocks keep the embedded \n). This is the only rule that shows them as separate lines. Without it each verse collapses into one run-on line. Font-size here is overridden by inline px from JS (reader.js:55,146).

mustPreserve.declarations: mark{background highlight; color:inherit} mark.current{distinct stronger background/colour}
mustPreserve.why: reader.js:293-316 wraps search matches in <mark>. reader.js:329-373 moves .current and scrolls to it for prev/next. The current match must look different from the other matches, or up/down navigation is meaningless.

reader.js:346 sets both disabled and hidden on .rs-nav. display:inline-flex beats the browser's default [hidden] rule, so hiding depends on design-system.css:23 [hidden]{display:none !important} (or reading.css:512), both being deleted. The new system must include a global [hidden] rule. .rs-clear is shown and hidden by inline style.display (reader.js:239; index.html:981).

This is the only sign that speech recognition is recording. reader.js:427-433 and app.js:198-210 toggle it. micPulse is also used by .mic-mini.listening (styles.css:1424) for the feedback mic (app.js:391-393). If the keyframes are dropped the pulse disappears.

The inputs remove their native outline. The only replacement focus indicator is .reader-search:focus-within. The main .search-input has no replacement in this range. If the rewrite keeps outline:none, it must add a focus-within ring on .search-input-wrap too, or keyboard focus is invisible.
The cards are <a class="card"> links (32 of them, e.g. index.html:623). This is their keyboard focus indicator.

mustPreserve.declarations: .card{position:relative; overflow:hidden} ::before/::after{position:absolute; pointer-events:none} ::after z-index:3 | .card-bg{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0} .card-deity-svg{position:absolute; top/left 50%; translate(-50%,-50%); z-index:1} .card-content{position:relative; z-index:2}
mustPreserve.why: The markup keeps .card-bg and .card-deity-svg on all 32 cards. Without a positioned, clipped .card these absolute children escape and spread over the page. pointer-events:none on the shimmer layer keeps taps reaching the link. The z-order keeps the text above the deity art. If the markup is simplified, remove the elements too.

mustPreserve.declarations: position:fixed; top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:650px; height:650px (350px at ≤700px); z-index:0; opacity:.04; pointer-events:none
mustPreserve.why: app.js:62-63 injects <svg style="width:100%;height:100%"> at full colour, so the container must give it a size and fade it. Otherwise it is either the default 300x150 or bright deity art over the verses. pointer-events:none keeps it from blocking taps. goHome clears it (app.js:102).

mustPreserve.declarations: position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none | .particle{position:absolute; animation:floatUp} (JS sets inline left, animationDelay, animationDuration)
mustPreserve.why: The divs at index.html:26-28 are always present. app.js:24-34 adds 35 .particle.gold/.big elements (skipped under reduced motion). design-system.css:22 currently hides all three. If the new system keeps them they must be fixed, behind content, and non-interactive. If not, hide them with display:none or remove the divs; otherwise the unstyled particles pile up in the page flow.

This is the only reduced-motion rule in lines 1-1000. The global reduced-motion kill-switches live in reading.css:62 and design-system.css:180, both being deleted, so the new system needs its own reduced-motion block.

mustPreserve.declarations: *{margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box} body{overflow-x:hidden; min-height:100vh} html{scroll-behavior:smooth} html,body{overflow-x:hidden; max-width:100%}
mustPreserve.why: These stop horizontal scroll on phones. Confetti is placed at left up to 100vw plus its width, and glows and SVGs use overflow:visible. scroll-behavior gives smooth anchor and skip-link jumps. Caveat: overflow-x:hidden on body while html is also non-visible makes body a scroll container, which by the CSS spec breaks position:sticky (not browser-verified). In the rewrite put overflow-x hidden/clip on html only.

The SVGs are sized only by viewBox plus CSS width, with no width/height attributes. Without the width they render at 300x150 or collapse. overflow:visible lets beads that JS culls at sy -30..452 (japamala.js:145), scaled flow beads, and drop-shadow glows draw outside the viewBox without clipping. Tap highlight is suppressed for fast repeated taps. Stage visibility per mode is set by INLINE style.display (japamala.js:78-82; index.html:1174,1183,1193 start with display:none), so never give .jm-stage a display rule with !important.
The thread <line> and <ellipse> elements (index.html:1166,1176,1185) have no stroke attribute. Without this rule the silk thread the beads hang on is invisible.

The JS-built tassel <path>s (japamala.js:125,196,249) have no fill or stroke attributes. Without fill:none they render as solid black shapes under the guru bead, and without stroke the tassel strands are invisible.

japamala.js:152-154 sets the transform and opacity attributes on every animation frame and toggles .cur. A transform/opacity transition (for example from a global * rule) would lag the spring animation, so beads must opt out. .cur is the only marker of the bead at the focus.

mustPreserve.declarations: .jm-fbead{transition:fill .25s ease; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center} .cur{stroke; stroke-width:1; filter:drop-shadow} .pop{animation:jmPop .3s ease} @keyframes jmPop{40%{transform:scale(1.9)}}
mustPreserve.why: The full-loop beads are <circle>s placed with cx/cy (japamala.js:183-187). Without transform-box:fill-box and transform-origin:center, scale(1.9) grows from the SVG origin and the bead jumps across the SVG. japamala.js:219 restarts .pop by removing it, forcing a reflow and re-adding it. japamala.js:215 toggles .cur.

mustPreserve.declarations: circle{transition:fill .25s ease} .cur circle{stroke:rgba(255,235,180,.95); stroke-width:1; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,223,133,.95))}
mustPreserve.why: japamala.js:238 creates the flow beads as <g> and :274-275 sets transform every frame and toggles .cur. Only fill may transition, never transform on the <g>.

japamala.js:357 removes, reflows and re-adds .celebrate when 108 beads are completed. In rudraksha3d mode the class lands on #jmRudrakshaCanvas, which is not .jm-svg, so this rule doesn't apply there.

mustPreserve.declarations: position:fixed; top:-20px; width:9px; height:14px; border-radius:2px; z-index:700; pointer-events:none; animation:jmFall linear forwards | @keyframes jmFall{to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(720deg); opacity:.15}}
mustPreserve.why: japamala.js:362-373 creates 60 divs and sets only inline left, background, animationDelay and animationDuration (1.8-3.0s). CSS supplies the size, fixed position and animation name. JS removes them at 3200ms. pointer-events:none is essential because the japamala page counts on every tap and confetti must not swallow taps. z-index 700 puts it above the overlays.

japamala.js:83-84 toggles .active by data-mode. This is the only sign of which mala look is selected. .jm-modes gets its display:flex from design-system.css:257, which is being deleted, so the new system must set flex itself.

The main count is drawn with a text-clipped gradient. If the transparent text fill is kept without the gradient background, the number becomes invisible. tabular-nums stops the count jittering. The min-height keeps #jmRounds from shifting the layout when JS switches it between '' and text (japamala.js:164).
These are the primary tap targets for the older audience. The inline stopPropagation stops a double count with the page-level tap handler. Keep them at least this large.

app.js:57 replaces #readerTitleSection className with 'reader-title-section ' + cfg.theme on every open, and admin-added stotras bring their own theme. Any other class put on #readerTitleSection in the markup is wiped. Style the element through its id, the base class or the theme class only.

No JS reads these. But japamala-3d.css:75,88, which is being kept, uses var(--gold-light) for the 3D hint and fallback text, so either define it in the new system or update that file. Separately, --reader-font-size is set by reader.js:147 and defaulted only in reading.css:2 (being deleted). The new system must declare :root{--reader-font-size:24px} and use it for .slokam-meaning and .reader-verse-number.

This is the positioning context for the ::before/::after decorations, and for the .slokam-block.read ✓ badge at styles.css:1664-1672 (reader.js:79,120 toggle .read). Jump-to-verse also relies on scroll-margin-top from reading.css:38, which the new system must carry over.

keyframesUsed: fadeInUp (345): runs on JS-added .active for .reader-page, .track-page, .japamala-page and .search-overlay. Nothing breaks without it; it only animates the show.
meaningSlide (584): runs when JS toggles body.show-meanings, .origin-block.visible and .reminder-banner.show.
micPulse (785): used by .rs-mic.listening, .mic-btn.listening and .mic-mini.listening (line 1424). This is the only 'recording' indicator for voice search. JS toggles the classes.
jmPop (908): used by .jm-fbead.pop. JS restarts it with remove, reflow, add (japamala.js:219). Needs transform-box:fill-box.
jmGlow (923): used by .jm-svg.celebrate. JS restarts it on completing a mala (japamala.js:357).
jmFall (949): used by the JS-created .jm-confetti elements. JS sets animationDelay/Duration inline and removes the elements at 3.2s, so the animation must finish in about 3s or less.
floatUp (85): used by the JS-created .particle elements (app.js:29, inline delay/duration). Decorative, and currently hidden by design-system.css:22.
jmFocusPulse (896): used by the .jm-focus ellipse in the markup. CSS only, decorative opacity pulse.
shimmerText (127): used by .header h1, .section-title, .reader-title-section h2, .footer, .track-section-head h2 and .jm-head. CSS only, decorative.
omBreathe (65): used by .particles::before. CSS only, decorative.
rotateRing (321): used by .card-icon-wrap::before. CSS only, decorative.
omPulse (167): DEAD. It is only applied to .om-symbol, which has no references.
beadGlowSvg (982), handPush (996): DEAD. They belong to the removed .mala-* ring view, which has no references in the markup or JS.
visualOnlyNotes:
These are free to redesign:
- All the gold, purple and maroon glass gradients, box-shadows, backdrop-filters and gold hairline ::before/::after rules on .header, .card, .reader-title-section, .font-control, .meaning-toggle, .reader-search, .origin-block, .slokam-block, .slokam-number, .meaning-label, .origin-label, .track-card, .search-input-wrap, .search-result, .jm-btn-* and .footer.
- Hover transforms, including .card:hover lift and .slokam-block:hover translateX. Hover effects stick on touch screens, so dropping them helps mobile.
- The per-deity tint colours: keep the class hooks, change the colours freely.
- The typography sizes and letter-spacing.
- The 3-slot header grid (738-743), which design-system.css and reading.css already override.
- The responsive card grid rules (710-725).
- The ఓం watermark and tiled field (51-77).
- .account-advanced summary marker hiding (796-797).

Two things to watch while redesigning:
- Many headings use background-clip:text with -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent: .header-om, .header h1, .section-title, .card h3, .reader-title-section h2, .track-section-head h2, .jm-head, #jmCount and the whole .footer. If you drop the gradient, also reset the text fill to currentColor. Otherwise the text disappears; .footer would also hide the .footer-feedback button text.
- The japamala gradients (gWood1-3, gMarker, gGuru, gGuruTop, gGold, gFocus) are SVG <defs> in the always-present 0-size svg.jm-defs at index.html:1138-1149, not CSS. Keep that element rendered: no display:none. JS fills reference url(#gGold) and the others.
